title: "Charlas"
title-en: "Talks"
# Don't freeze: the cards come from talks.yml, not from this .qmd. Under
# `freeze: auto` Quarto only re-executes when the .qmd itself changes, so
# edits to talks.yml would silently not appear. freeze:false keeps it live.
freeze: false
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os, html, re, yaml

# Resolve the data file whether the kernel runs from pages/ or the project root.
for candidate in ("talks.yml", "pages/talks.yml"):
    if os.path.exists(candidate):
        with open(candidate, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            talks = yaml.safe_load(f)
        break
else:
    talks = []

# We emit BOTH languages and let Quarto's `content-visible when-profile` filter
# keep only the active one. We deliberately do NOT branch on QUARTO_PROFILE here:
# Quarto reuses a persistent Jupyter kernel across the esp/eng builds, so the
# env var is frozen at whatever the kernel first launched with and would leak
# one language into the other. The content-visible filter runs every render
# (after freeze, independent of the kernel), so it switches reliably.
LANGS = {
    # lang -> (quarto profile, UI strings, English-fallback flag)
    "es": {"profile": "esp", "more": "Ver más", "close": "Cerrar", "where": "Presentada en", "video": "video"},
    "en": {"profile": "eng", "more": "Read more", "close": "Close", "where": "Presented at", "video": "video"},
}

_MD_LINK = re.compile(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)")


def field(item, key, lang):
    """Localized field with English -> Spanish fallback. Inline markdown links
    are converted to HTML, since modal bodies are emitted as raw HTML (where
    pandoc would not process markdown)."""
    val = item.get(f"{key}_en") if (lang == "en" and item.get(f"{key}_en")) else item.get(key, "")
    return _MD_LINK.sub(r'<a href="\2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">\1</a>', val)


def md_links(links):
    return " · ".join(
        f'<a href="{html.escape(l["href"])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{html.escape(l["text"])}</a>'
        for l in (links or [])
    )


def oneline(s):
    """Collapse generated HTML to a single unindented line. With `output: asis`
    pandoc parses the printed text as markdown, where any 4-space-indented line
    becomes a code block; emitting one flat line keeps it a raw HTML block."""
    return "".join(line.strip() for line in s.splitlines())


def render_lang(lang):
    ui = LANGS[lang]
    cards, modals = [], []
    for i, t in enumerate(talks):
        mid = f"talk-{lang}-{i}"  # lang-suffixed so the two builds never collide
        title = html.escape(field(t, "title", lang))
        event = html.escape(t.get("event", ""))
        date = html.escape(str(t.get("date", "")))
        meta = " · ".join(p for p in (date, event) if p)

        if t.get("image"):
            media = f'<div class="talk-card-media"><img src="{html.escape(t["image"])}" alt="{title}"></div>'
        else:
            media = f'<div class="talk-card-media placeholder">{event}</div>'

        cards.append(oneline(f'''
<div class="card talk-card" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#{mid}">
{media}
<div class="card-body">
<span class="talk-meta">{meta}</span>
<h5 class="card-title">{title}</h5>
<span class="btn btn-primary btn-sm mt-auto align-self-start">{ui["more"]}</span>
</div>
</div>'''))

        body = ""
        venues = t.get("venues")
        if venues:
            items = ""
            for v in venues:
                vlink = f' — <a href="{html.escape(v["video"])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{ui["video"]}</a>' if v.get("video") else ""
                items += f'<li><strong>{html.escape(v["event"])}</strong> ({html.escape(str(v.get("date","")))}){vlink}</li>'
            body += f'<p class="mb-1"><strong>{ui["where"]}:</strong></p><ul class="talk-modal-venues">{items}</ul>'

        body += f'<div>{field(t, "description", lang)}</div>'

        links = md_links(t.get("links"))
        if links:
            body += f'<p class="mt-3">{links}</p>'

        modals.append(oneline(f'''
<div class="modal fade" id="{mid}" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
<div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-dialog-scrollable">
<div class="modal-content">
<div class="modal-header">
<h5 class="modal-title">{title}</h5>
<button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="{ui["close"]}"></button>
</div>
<div class="modal-body">{body}</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>'''))

    return '<div class="talk-grid">' + "".join(cards) + "</div>\n" + "\n".join(modals)


for lang, cfg in LANGS.items():
    print(f'\n::: {{.content-visible when-profile="{cfg["profile"]}"}}\n')
    print(render_lang(lang))
    print('\n:::\n')
```
